question: Compare the reported PCE distributions of p-i-n and n-i-p perovskite solar cells in the database. Report the number of records and the mean and median PCE for each architecture.
final_answer: n-i-p mean PCE is 12.11% and p-i-n mean is 11.94%, but record counts and medians were not established.

args.query: SELECT Cell_architecture, COUNT(*) AS n_records, AVG(JV_default_PCE) AS mean_pce FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture IN ('nip','pin') AND JV_default_PCE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Cell_architecture

SELECT Cell_architecture, AVG(p) AS median_pce FROM (SELECT Cell_architecture, JV_default_PCE AS p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Cell_architecture ORDER BY JV_default_PCE) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY Cell_architecture) AS n FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture IN ('nip','pin') AND JV_default_PCE IS NOT NULL) WHERE rn IN ((n+1)/2, (n+2)/2) GROUP BY Cell_architecture
